name: Takayanagi Kaori
source: A well-known lady in the school, in addition to tea ceremony, she also enjoys flower arrangement and Japanese dance. Her family donates a large amount of money to the school, and the teachers look up to her. She and the student council president have a close family relationship, as their fathers have been close friends for a long time. Rumor has it that she is his fiance. Because of her natural aura of nobility, she is the "big sister" that her fellow underclassmen look up to.
